Cover/executive summary, no figure. Cadre de l'action anticipatoire, Pilote Tchad: Sècheresse, version finale du 24 octobre 2022. Trigger model: Fenêtre 1 (mars/avril, IRI forecast ≥42.5% probability below-average July-Aug-Sept rainfall), Fenêtre 2 (mai/juin, same 42.5% IRI threshold), Fenêtre 3 (septembre, biomass observation ≥80% anomaly).

--- page 2 ---
Table: budget by window/agency (FAO, PAM, UNICEF, UNHCR, UNFPA) totaling $10,000,000 - Fenêtre 1 "protection des moyens d'existence" (récolte principale, trigger mars/avril) = $3,710,000 (FAO 2,270,000; PAM 1,390,000; UNICEF 50,000); Fenêtre 2 (récolte maraîchère et cheptel, trigger mai/juin) = $1,660,000 (FAO 590,000; PAM 1,070,000); Fenêtre 3 "mitiger les impacts humanitaires précoces" (trigger septembre) = $4,630,000 (FAO 690,000; PAM 1,090,000; UNICEF 2,290,000; UNHCR 130,000; UNFPA 430,000). Below: schematic timeline (Année 1 mars–décembre, Année 2 janvier–juin) showing 3 potential trigger moments (stars) mapped to AA package 1 (protection récolte principale), package 2 (récolte maraîchère/bétail), package 3 (bétail + reduction of early humanitarian impacts), and the post-drought pastoral/agricultural soudure periods.

--- page 5 ---
Diagram "Réduction de l'impact d'un choc prévisible à travers l'action anticipatoire": compares traditional response curve (grey, later peak) vs. anticipatory action curve (blue, earlier intervention at "Action Anticipatoire" point using prévision robuste, planning/prioritizing, mobilizing/allocating funding) resulting in "réponse humanitaire plus vite, efficace, efficient, et digne".

--- page 7 ---
Map figure: 8 small maps of Chad (1993, 1997, 2001, 2004, 2009, 2011, 2016, 2017) showing precipitation anomalies for July-Aug-Sept, color scale purple/red (drought/below-average) to blue (above-average); 2004 and 2009 show most extensive dark purple (severe deficit) coverage. Text: lake Chad shrank from 25,000 km² (1963) to ~2,500 km² today; INFORM risk index Chad 7.2/10 (3rd most at-risk country); vulnerability 7.6/10, lack of coping capacity 8.9/10; province du Lac has highest risk index 7.7/10, Wadi Fira lowest adaptability 9.361/10 (sic, likely inverted).

Causal-loop diagram (Jun–May calendar) tracing "mauvaise saison de pluies" through groundwater/surface water/pasture/harvest failures to downstream impacts: transhumance précoce, conflits agriculteurs-éleveurs, prix élevé de l'eau, réduction de récolte, baisse de pouvoir d'achat, malnutrition, descolarisation, incidents de protection, complications médicales chez enfants et FEFA. Below: institutional framework narrative (RPCA/PREGEC, CILSS, AGRHYMET, SISAAP).

Bottom bar chart "Historical drought trigger activations and shocks" (biomass 80% anomaly threshold, Sept): 5 shocks / 5 activations = 2 missed shocks, 3 valid activations, 2 false activations.
